title: at edit's register row says --kind is deliberately absent, and the verb has taken it since 0146
body:
`surface/dispatch-table.json`'s `at edit` row says, in its `target.consequence`: "`--status` and `--kind` ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT". The verb has taken `--kind` since issue 0146, and issues 0324 and 0337 made `--kind` the single edge of `AcceptanceTest.kind`: a re-kind re-enters the status at `AtStatus::entry`. The register row therefore denies a flag the row itself declares, and the rendered `dispatch-table.md` repeats the denial.

Found by ic on 2026-09-14 while building vc's re-kind ruling for 0324+0337; vc ruled it filed as its own XS issue rather than folded into that commit.

The fix: correct the consequence forward. `--status` stays absent (`at green` / `at red` / `at na` own status). `--kind` is present and re-enters the entry status. Regenerate `dispatch-table.md` in the same commit.

**CLOSED 2026-09-15, landed on vc's word with issue 0334.** `at edit`'s register row now says `--status` is deliberately absent and `--kind` is present: the single edge of `AcceptanceTest.kind`, re-entering the status at `AtStatus::entry` and refused when the row's status cannot hold the new kind. `dispatch-table.md` is regenerated in the same commit.
